lines.en: I take heavy, clumsy steps.

lines.zh: 我的鳍状手臂一摇一摆。
lines.en: My flipper arms swing as I go.

lines.zh: 木板地被我踩得吱呀响。
lines.en: The boards creak under my tread.
I shift slowly through the hall.

lines.zh: 我张开手臂，占了半条道。
lines.en: I spread my arms and take half the aisle.
Step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我一走，影子盖住整扇门。
lines.en: One step and my shadow covers the door.
Turning around takes me a long while.
I reach the stage edge and stop.
My steps are steady; I can't be tipped.
I shift slowly to the corner.

lines.zh: 我一走动，尘土就飞起来。
lines.en: When I move, dust rises.
I stand with my mouth open.
My flippers hang at my sides.
I listen, but it's very quiet.
By day I become an exhibit.

lines.zh: 我的皮套里没多少活动空间。
lines.en: There's little room inside my suit.
I close my mouth slowly, then open it.
I've stood in this place many years.
The lamp shines on my teeth.
The display case light is on me.
I wait for the night shift.

lines.zh: 我这副海象身子，卡在门框里。
lines.en: This walrus body of mine jams in the doorway.
Round eyes, never blinking.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一直张着，别介意。
lines.en: My mouth stays open; don't mind it.

lines.zh: 你在这站着，是在等我吗？
lines.en: Standing here — waiting for me?
My teeth don't bite. Usually.

lines.zh: 我微微侧头，皮套发出响声。
lines.en: I tilt my head with a creak of the suit.
You're warmer than the freezer.

lines.zh: 这展厅晚上只有你和我。
lines.en: Tonight it's only you and me in here.
I remember you walking this way.
I raise an arm, flipper fanning out.
My suit has been slit open.
That one landed solidly.
I sway, but don't fall.

lines.zh: 里面填充的东西掉出来。
lines.en: The stuffing is coming out.
A body like mine doesn't topple.
My walrus tusks click together.
You hit my support frame.
It's fine; I can still move.
I've noted your strength.
Thick suit outside, iron inside.
For me? I'll take it.
A body like mine can't eat.
But I still want to hold it.
I reach out a flipper.
This smell is a little familiar.
Where's the fish? Only fish count.
I hold it and stand a long while.

lines.zh: 你的手离开时，我会有点失落。
lines.en: When your hand leaves, I'll feel a little lost.
I'll walk with you a stretch.
Let's call it your gift.
Bump me, and your shoulder goes numb first.
This frame is not easily shoved.
Don't crowd me; I can't turn.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的鳍上，软软的。
lines.en: You hit my flipper; it's soft.
I stand firm, barely moving.
This passage is too narrow.
I turn aside to let you squeeze by.
Your shoving is like wind to me.
What I block doesn't pass.

lines.zh: 地板在我的重量下呻吟。
lines.en: The floor groans under my weight.
Another one sits on the shelf.

lines.zh: 我们的皮套是同一个模子。
lines.en: Our suits came from one mold.

lines.zh: 我们一起站在展台两边。
lines.en: We stand on either side of the display.
Her teeth show too.
Only at night do we move.

lines.zh: 我慢慢举起鳍，向她致意。
lines.en: I slowly raise a flipper to greet her.

lines.zh: 这地方太大，我们隔得远。
lines.en: It's too big here; we're far apart.
When the light dims, we come closer.
Tomorrow we'll stand back in place.
I'll remember tonight.
I nudge it over with a flipper.
I can't bend; I must squat.
This is mine to keep.
Nobody gets this fish.
These tusks of mine are plastic.
Things shouldn't be left on the floor.
It feels good in hand.
I'll set it on the stage.
I can manage this small task.
I pick it up slowly.
Now there's a slit in my suit.
My tusks show pale in the dark.
Now it's my turn.
I spread both arms.
You provoked me; that's clear.
The hall doors are already shut.
My flipper hand rises to my chest.
My steps have quickened a touch.
These two long tusks give me away.
Ice blocks stack to the ceiling.
No hurry; you can't get away.
I raise a hand and open my mouth.
You're within my reach.
Don't shout; these walls are thick.
My tusks click together.
I don't shove; I press.
I waddle toward you.
However fast you run, you must turn back.

lines.zh: 我的胡子是画的，别当真。
lines.en: My mustache is painted on, do not be fooled.

lines.zh: 我的重量让地板都在响。
lines.en: My weight makes the floor ring.
I smell the white breath you exhale.

lines.zh: 你别想从我旁边挤过去。
lines.en: You won't squeeze past me.
I raise an arm across the doorway.
The distance shrinks bit by bit.
I heard you hit the table.
I know everything in this place.
Stop hiding; I can see you.
I close in slowly, unhurried.

lines.zh: 你的心跳撞在柜台上，我听见。
lines.en: Your heartbeat knocks against the counter. I hear it.
A few more steps and I'm there.
The motor in my belly whirs.
This position is just right.
I raise a flipper to shoulder height.
The ice is slick. Don't run.

lines.zh: 我听见你脚下的木板响。
lines.en: I hear the boards creak under you.
Good, close enough.
The walrus suit bears down on you.
My flipper bears down on your shoulder.
This blow sends you staggering back.
I open my mouth and my teeth close.
My weight is nearly impossible to stop.
You're pressed to the wall.
The floor creaked once.
I bring a hand down flat.
You stagger back into a chair.
I lower my head near your face.
Even my suit shook from that.
My teeth are blunt, but heavy.
You're up again; stubborn.
My thick hand swings across.
Only your breathing is left in the hall.
I stand and watch you.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，把你挤到墙上。
lines.en: I turn and pin you against the wall.

lines.zh: 我的鳍扫过桌子，东西全掉了。
lines.en: My flipper sweeps the table clean.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了整个重量。
lines.en: This time I used my whole weight.
You're covered by my shadow.
I come out from behind the display.
The lights come on and I'm already here.
Wally Walrus, good evening.
My flippers catch the light.
The hall is mine to patrol tonight.
I've always been here, only still.
By day I'm an ornament.
Did you hear the boards creak?
I slowly spread my arms.
There's a smell of old cotton here.
When I move, dust floats up.
Welcome to the night shift.

lines.zh: 我的皮套烧起来，棉花冒烟。
lines.en: My suit burns and the cotton smokes.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上滚下去，翻了个身。
lines.en: I roll down the stairs and flip over.

lines.zh: 水从嘴里灌进去，里面全湿了。
lines.en: Water pours in through my mouth and soaks me inside.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得撞上展台。
lines.en: The blast slams me into the display.
An arrow sticks in my flipper.
This light leaves me unable to move.
The mechanism inside turns slower and slower.
The thunder makes me shake all over.

lines.zh: 没有地板，我的重量无处可放。
lines.en: No floor; my weight has nowhere to rest.
